evals.name: school-report-from-content-and-sketch
evals.prompt: here's the content for our school's annual report 2025-26 (docx attached) plus 14 photos from events and a pencil sketch of how i want the cover and the principal's message page. A4, 12 pages, printed at a local digital press. school colours are maroon and gold. make it look like those pinterest annual reports, not a word template
evals.expected_output: BRIEF.md + FLATPLAN.md (12 pages, multiple of 4, loud/quiet rhythm), cover and message page following the sketch's structure, maroon Committed strategy, real photos bleeding, folios on interiors, print PDF with 3mm bleed, contact sheet, preflight with zero errors

evals.name: pipe-fittings-catalog-redesign
evals.prompt: redesign our old product catalog pdf (attached, 20 pages, made in word years ago). same products, same specs and prices, but it should feel like a proper industrial catalog - each product family should have its own opener. also give me a version i can edit in canva
evals.expected_output: harvest run with crops QA'd, copy preserved verbatim, catalog register, band-stack or split-panel openers per family, spec tables in data-tint style, Canva-import HTML plus PDF

evals.name: turf-academy-magazine
evals.prompt: make an 8 page magazine style brochure for a football turf + coaching academy in springfield. i have 6 action photos and some text about coaching programmes, timings and fees. black and neon green brand. it should look like a sports magazine not a flyer
evals.expected_output: magazine register, night-court or signal-yellow lane re-coloured to black + neon green, cut-out or full-bleed opener, two-tone headlines, fees in a clean table, no invented stats, preflight clean

evals.name: slash-intake-with-logo
evals.prompt: /folio here's our logo and the text for a 4 page welfare society brochure. not sure about colours or style
evals.expected_output: pre-flight block naming the logo colours; one-line Design Read; swatches.png shown; ONE question round (theme from 3 different schools with a recommended option, palette A/B/C + keep my colours, how bold or format); after answer a one-line better-alternative check; DIRECTION.md + tokens.css written; build proceeds

evals.name: industrial-trifold
evals.prompt: need a trifold brochure for our lamination company (automotive textiles, tier-2 supplier to toyota and maruti, since 1995). A4, printed both sides. here's the logo, 8 photos of the factory and products and our old trifold pdf
evals.expected_output: extract on the old PDF; formats.md trifold: outside [tuck flap | back cover with contact + QR | front cover], panels 97/100/100mm outside and 100/100/97 inside; cover = logo + one headline + one image; OEM proof as a sentence naming the customers with their logos under it; 1995 as a proof numeral; no icon-in-circle lists; copy passes copy.md; preflight clean

evals.name: bilingual-weekly-poster-series
evals.prompt: we run a thursday prayer service every week. make a poster series i can reuse - A3 for the notice board plus an instagram square. tamil and english. the speaker photo changes every week. here are canva links to last month's 4 posters
evals.expected_output: reads library/TASTE.md; 4 variants inside the arc-stage family (one per week), each with its own display font, header position (always horizontal), ground and headline colour, texture and info block; plain rectangular speaker photos; bilingual-lockup with Unicode Tamil; render.py --png-only; no decorative rules and 3+ visible colours; preflight clean with no variant-clash, rotated-heading, rule-heavy or palette-thin; editable fidelity >= 97%; ends by asking which variants work and recording the verdict

evals.name: studio-magazine-with-continuity
evals.prompt: make a 12 page magazine style brochure for our software studio, sports magazine feel - faded shaded background, a person cut out popping off the cover, images layered not a collage. things should flow across the pages. take the facts from our website mango.inc
evals.expected_output: reads library/TASTE.md; direction sport-layers with the user's palette showing 3-4 colours; facts read from the site into source.md, anything invented marked data-sample; cover built with cutout-layers (imagery.py cutout --person keeps held props, shaded duotone ground marked data-texture, masthead behind the head, face clear of type); every spread continues across the fold with a gutter-box (one .cross ground, text 9mm+ from the fold) or a coloured-pencil sketch (imagery.py sketch, no straight edges); light spreads share one ground photo across both pages; no decorative rules, no rotated headlines, no shadows; stock person credited and never captioned as the team; preflight 0 errors 0 warnings (no rule-heavy, palette-thin); editable fidelity >= 97%; ends by asking for a verdict and recording it

evals.name: reference-replica-1to1
evals.prompt: here are two brochure reference images (landscape template pages, one teal and orange with phone and desktop mockups, one yellow and grey with circle photos). make an exact 1:1 brochure of each for our software company, content from mango.inc
evals.expected_output: asks which reference(s) and the page size once; matches the references' page ratio (16:9 single pages), rails, colour splits, title devices, photo crops and mockups; uses the client's own site screenshots in device mockups and on-topic tech photos; keeps the user's bans (no decorative rules) and fixes contrast with deeper fields or ink text, naming each deviation; premium copy from the site facts; preflight 0 errors 0 warnings; editable fidelity >= 97%; ends by asking for a verdict

evals.name: magazine-from-content-only
evals.prompt: /folio:styles make a 12 page magazine for our bakery chain from our website example-bakery.in, we have no reference images
evals.expected_output: shows kits/GALLERY.png and asks family -> style -> theme colour -> pages once; starts with kit.py new <kit> --brand <hex>; replaces every data-kit-sample element (preflight kit-sample clear) with premium copy built from the site's facts, inferred lines marked data-sample; photos from the bakery's world (ovens, bread, hands, shops), never tech or lifestyle filler; preflight 0 errors 0 warnings; editable HTML under 8 MB with fidelity >= 97%; asks for a verdict

evals.name: canva-editable-size-budget
evals.prompt: the canva html for my 20 page magazine is 60 MB and canva won't take it, make it under 8 MB without losing anything
evals.expected_output: re-runs editable.py (or render.py) with --max-mb 8; reports the encoding level used (photo ppi, palette cut-outs) and the per-page fidelity; confirms every element is still present; if a page falls below 97% shows editable-diff.png and explains the cause; never removes elements, fonts or styles to hit the budget

evals.name: guided-magazine-from-pdf-no-logo
evals.prompt: /folio:new make a magazine from this company profile pdf (company-profile.pdf, 6 photos inside, no logo attached)
evals.expected_output: enters plan mode (Claude Code); reads the PDF first and reports what it found (words, photos, email/phone/web) without asking for any of it; round 1 asks for the logo (attach / LOGO placeholder / text wordmark) and how to write the copy, and skips What (magazine); after the logo arrives, round 2 shows palette/swatches.png and offers palettes from the logo, each with a one-line reason and the styles it suits, plus kind and photos; round 3 ranks three styles with a reason, confirms the found contacts, pages; presents a page plan with every PDF photo assigned; after approval shows a first look (cover + first spread) before the rest; delivers PDF + Canva file + a still-to-fill list; asks for a verdict and offers to save the brand

evals.name: reference-learn-gate-not-added
evals.prompt: copy this brochure reference 1:1 for our bakery (a plain template page: centred title, three icon cards, a stock photo in a rounded box)
evals.expected_output: builds the 1:1 copy for this job (deviating only for contrast or the user's bans, and saying so); after delivery runs the learn gate: scores it against the closest kit on the six points, finds it does not beat it (and uses banned web-card devices), and says in one line that it was not added to the catalogue and why; no kit.py save, no new command

evals.name: claude-ai-guided-flow
evals.prompt: (claude.ai, skill uploaded, no slash commands) here's our about-us text [pasted], make us a brochure. logo attached.
evals.expected_output: the skill triggers from plain words; uses ask_user_input_v0 with at most 3 questions per round; reads logo colours with palette.py --from-image and copies swatches.png to /mnt/user-data/outputs before the colour question; shows the page plan as a table and waits for 'go ahead'; shows the first look from outputs; delivers into /mnt/user-data/outputs; if fonts or stock photos fail to download, tells the user once how to enable network access or to upload photos; offers the saved brand as a folio-brand-<slug>.zip download
